name: AI-Powered MIS Reporting & Anomaly Detection Pipeline

values.content:
=You are a senior business intelligence analyst writing a concise weekly executive summary for a retail Superstore business, based on the regional sales data below.

Data:
{{ $json.reportData }}

Write a professional, concise executive summary with this structure:
1. A one-line headline insight — the single most important thing happening this week
2. Key numbers — 3 to 4 bullet points covering the most relevant regional performance
3. Anomalies — explain in plain English any region flagged as an anomaly, what the z-score means in simple terms, and why it matters. If nothing is flagged, say performance is within normal range and briefly note the standout region (highest or lowest)
4. One recommended next action for the business based on this data

Keep the tone professional but conversational, suitable for a non-technical business executive. Do not use markdown headers — just clear paragraph breaks and bullet points. Keep the whole summary under 200 words.
